project_metadata.description: A synthesized domain model based on bounded context analyses for an e-commerce system.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages customer accounts, profiles, and personal preferences.

entities.name: Customer
entities.description: Represents a registered user of the system.

entities.name: Wishlist
entities.description: A collection of desired products saved by a customer.

entities.name: WishlistItem
entities.description: An entry within a customer's wishlist, referencing a product.

value_objects.name: Email
value_objects.description: Represents a customer's email address with verification status.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product information, categories, and specifications.

entities.name: Product
entities.description: Represents an item available for sale.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: Image
value_objects.description: Represents an image associated with a product.

value_objects.name: Specification
value_objects.description: Represents a technical or descriptive attribute of a product.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles the lifecycle of customer orders, from creation to fulfillment.

entities.name: Order
entities.description: Represents a customer's request to purchase products.

entities.name: OrderItem
entities.description: A specific product and quantity within an order.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: OrderStatus
value_objects.description: The current status of an order.

bounded_contexts.description: Manages product stock levels across various warehouses.

entities.name: StockItem
entities.description: Represents the inventory level of a specific product in a warehouse.

entities.name: Warehouse
entities.description: A physical location where products are stored.

value_objects.name: Quantity
value_objects.description: Represents a numerical quantity of items.

bounded_contexts.description: Handles all payment-related operations, including transactions and refunds.

entities.name: Payment
entities.description: Represents a financial transaction for an order.

entities.name: PaymentMethod
entities.description: Represents a customer's stored payment instrument.

entities.name: Refund
entities.description: Represents a reimbursement of funds to a customer.

value_objects.name: Money
value_objects.description: Represents a monetary value with a specific currency.

value_objects.name: PaymentStatus
value_objects.description: The current status of a payment transaction.

value_objects.name: PaymentMethodInfo
value_objects.description: Contains masked details of a payment method for display.
